name: 24573-longprompt-30bmoe-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, four GPUs of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=4 with expert parallelism on, so each rank owns 32 whole experts of every MoE layer; PP=1, DP=1. Load balancer enabled, 0 redundant experts, rearrangement interval pinned past the end of the run.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1000, bounded at 2000 requests / 1800 s safety, first 10% warmup and last 10% cooldown by completion. All 1000 prompts are released at once and every one is held open.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 1000 tokens and output exactly 100 with ignore_eos forced, Faker-generated synthetic English, request_format plain at temperature 0.0 against /v1/completions.
purpose: A document analysis assistant summarizing thousand-token passages for a thousand concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# Engine: commit 175811e3b53f8f13eb3e8ac6aae02050f6e1412f (git describe
# v0.10.2rc2-344-g175811e3b5). Interpreter and hardware are in configs/env.yaml.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B

# Expert parallelism is required for the balancer: parallel.py at this commit refuses
# enable-eplb unless the platform is CUDA, expert parallelism is on, and tp * dp > 1.
tensor-parallel-size: 4
enable-expert-parallel: true
enable-eplb: true

# Zero redundant experts, and an interval that puts the first rearrangement far past the end
# of the run, so no expert ever moves.
# HAZARD: these three keys must stay FLAT. At this commit the deprecated flat engine
# arguments are forwarded unconditionally on top of --eplb-config, so a nested `eplb-config`
# mapping is silently overwritten and the pin does not take.
num-redundant-experts: 0
eplb-window-size: 1000
eplb-step-interval: 1000000

# This engine defaults prefix caching ON for a generation model, so this is a real change.
enable-prefix-caching: false

# HAZARD: load-bearing, do not delete as "the default". The async engine path is in neither
# per-context table of _set_default_args_v1, so an unpinned run falls through to the library
# defaults of config/scheduler.py -- 128 sequences, an eighth of the concurrency declared here.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

# V1 forces chunked prefill on for a generation model at this commit.
enable-chunked-prefill: true

# The checkpoint would otherwise give 40960. The worst case here is 1000 + 100 = 1100 tokens.
max-model-len: 2048

# This engine's own default, written down.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
